title: Regret-matching policy update failed to transfer local payoff gains
status: Fresh counterfactual fit complete; rejected before full-match evaluation

candidate_restricted_mixed_distribution.scope: actor probabilities renormalized over only the collected candidate actions

absolute_joint_probability_diagnostic.description: true actor probability mass on measured candidate actions; unmeasured legal-action mass contributes zero relative to incumbent, so this is not a full-policy value estimate

interpretation: The local action-payoff signal is present, but this actor projection failed to make useful action changes. On held-out states it changed the deterministic selected candidate only once in 25 states; the sampled candidate probability mass was harmful on measured worst-response outcomes. Do not deploy or evaluate this checkpoint as a strength candidate. Round430 remains active.
next_step: Improve the policy action representation or use a higher-capacity, better-regularized decision head; collect a new team-disjoint train/validation/test set before any fresh full-match evaluation.
metric_note: Round565 added 83 states at 61.13 counterfactual branches/sec. Across 126 combined step-3 states, regret-matching targets lowered validation loss to 4.42, but the actor changed its argmax action in only 1/25 held-out states; worst-response gain was 0.00.
information_note: The actor’s measured candidate probability mass contributed −4.28 pp to worst-response value [−7.16,−1.98] on the held-out subset. This is not a full-policy estimate, but rejects the fit. No full-match screen or promotion.
